item.title: Abandoned stationary vehicle (LY73 FVT) filled with rubbish for over 2 weeks, 25th October
item.description:
A black Nissan Qashqai (registration: LY73 FVT) has been dumped and continuously stationary in the residential parking bay outside 57 Goldfinch Road, SE28 0DF since 11/10/2026 (for over 14 days) without moving. The vehicle does not belong to any local resident in this street. More importantly, the vehicle's interior is packed with rubbish and bags of waste, exhibiting clear statutory signs of abandonment and creating an environmental nuisance in a residential area. This issue has also been officially logged with the Metropolitan Police (Police Reference: BCA-77146-26-0101-IR). Under the Refuse Disposal (Amenity) Act 1978, a vehicle can be classed as abandoned even if currently taxed when it exhibits neglect and is packed with rubbish. Please arrange for a local enforcement officer to inspect the vehicle and issue a statutory removal notice.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Goldfinch Road, Thamesmead
Report on FixMyStreet
